question: A loss of 12% is incurred when an article is sold for Rs. 242, To get a profit of 15%, the article should be sold for (in Rs.) =
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Selling Price 1 (100% − 12% = 88%) = 242

Unitary Value: 1% = 242 ÷ 88 = 2.75

Required Selling Price (100% + 15% = 115%) = 2.75 × 115

New Selling Price = 316.25

**∴ The correct answer is 316.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Selling Price (SP₁) = Rs. 242

Initial Loss = 12%

Target Profit = 15%

**Formula used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP × [100 / (100 − Loss%)]

New Selling Price (SP₂) = CP × [(100 + Profit%) / 100]

 
• 
 
 CP
 
 SP1 (242)
 
 SP2 (?)
 

 −12% Loss
 

 +15% Profit

**Calculations:**

⇒ CP = 242 × [100 / (100 − 12)]

⇒ CP = 242 × (100 / 88)

⇒ CP = 242 ÷ 0.88 = 275

⇒ SP₂ = 275 × [(100 + 15) / 100]

⇒ SP₂ = 275 × (115 / 100)

⇒ SP₂ = 275 × 1.15

⇒ SP₂ = 316.25

**∴ The correct answer is 316.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price and Discount

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 − Discount/100). The relation between CP and MP is CP/MP = (100 − D%)/(100 + P%).

Successive Discounts

Total discount for two successive discounts x% and y% = (x + y − xy/100)%.

Dishonest Dealer

Profit % = [Error / (True Value − Error)] × 100, where Error is the weight difference.</p
